The field value will be a valid record URL in the form `https://my.living-apps.de/rest/apps/6ad30b8e0042e397617f53a8/records/<record-id>` (or `null`/`None`).

When writing, either pass a record URL through exactly as this API returned it, or send the portable relative form `/apps/6ad30b8e0042e397617f53a8/records/<record-id>`. Other equivalent record-URL forms are accepted as well.

Displayed as single-select field in HTML pages.

art.label: Art der Erfahrung
art.description:
One selected option of multiple available options (or `null`/`None`).

The available options are defined in the `lookup_data` attribute of this control.

The field value will be the key in this `lookup_data` attribute (or `null`/`None`).

Displayed as single-select field in HTML pages.
